pr_title: Exclude protected beatmaps from consideration in several places
pr_body:
RFC.

- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/28880
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/23199

In particular:

- Song select will not permit `Beatmap.Value` to switch to a protected beatmap (will roll back to old value instead). This is mostly a safety rather than a proper fix.
- Protected beatmaps are not shown in now playing overlay (thus they can't be navigated to, preventing the breakage)
- Protected beatmaps are not considered by music controller when using previous/next buttons (knock-on fix of undesirable effects of the other changes)

issue_context.title: Starting the beatmap after playing cYsmix - triangles in "now playing" starts a non-existent beatmap
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Playing cYsmix - triangles from the now playing screen then starting the beatmap (by pressing enter or clicking the cookie) starts a beatmap that I can best describe as a "ghost beatmap", it has the default difficulty settings and is "mapped by peppy"
